- $\sum_{i=2}^{28} F_i = F_{30} - 2 = 832038$, using $F_{30} = 832040$.
- $\log_3 2 = 1/\log_2 3$, so $\sqrt{\log_2 P} = \dfrac{832038}{\sqrt{\log_2 3}}$.

With $\log_2 3 \approx 1.5849625$, this gives $\sqrt{\log_2 P} \approx 832038 / 1.2587947 \approx 660{,}980$, which is not 588333. The correct value is $832038/\sqrt{\log_2 3}$, with $\log_2 3$ kept as is.
